findings: CO unit conversion mismatch between databases — The provider stores CO in mg/m³, but the US EPA calculator initially assumed µg/m³, causing a 1000x error. Fixed in verification pass (corrected conversion factor from 1,145,000 to 1,145). Add a docstring to Measurement.value specifying canonical units per parameter.

European AQI band boundaries are thresholds, not interpolated breakpoints — The European calculator uses < for the upper bound check but the last band uses float('inf'). A concentration exactly at a threshold (e.g., 10.0 µg/m³ PM2.5) falls into the higher band due to the exclusive upper bound. Verify this matches EEA spec.

Resolver mapping uses EEA for countries with national indices — UK (GB) and Germany (DE) have their own AQI systems (DAQI, UBA) but the resolver maps them to European. Users in these countries will see EEA categories instead of their familiar national ones. Document this in API docs or add a note in the unavailable message for these countries.
